content: प्रतीप {%a.%} [प्रतिगताः आपो यत्र, प्रतिअप् अच्, अप ईप् च्] .²1 Contrary, unfavourable, adverse, opposite; तत्प्रतीपपवनादि वैकृतम् <ls>R. 11. 62</ls>; <ls>Ki. 14. 60</ls>. .²2 Reverse, inverted, out of order. .²3 Backward, retrograde. .²4 Disagreeable, displeasing. .²5 Refractory, disobedient, obstinate, perverse; प्रेष्यः प्रतीपोऽधिकृतः प्रमादी (त्याज्याः) <ls>Pt. 1. 424</ls>. .²6 Turned away, averted. .²7 Meeting, encountering. .²8 Hindering. .{@-पः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a king, father of Śantanu and grand-father of Bhīṣma. .²2 An adversary, opponent; चरति मयि रणे यश्च यश्च प्रतीपः <ls>Ve. 3. 32</ls>. .{@-पम्@} <ab>N.</ab> of a figure of speech in which the usual form of comparison is inverted, the उपमान being compared with the उपमेय; प्रतीपमुपमानस्याप्युपमेयत्वकल्पनम् . त्वल्लोचनसमं पद्मं त्वद्वक्त्रसदृशो विधुः .. <ls>Chandr. 5. 9</ls>; (for fuller definitions and explanation see <ls>K. P. 10</ls> under प्रतीप). .{@-पम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 On the contrary. .²2 In an inverted order. .²3 Against, in opposition to; भर्तृर्विप्रकृतापि रोषणतया मा स्म प्रतीपं गमः <ls>Ś. 4. 18</ls>.
